test_fp8_block_quantized_model: test an FP8 block quantized model by checking weight dtype and converting CompressedLinear layers to high precision
test_w4a16_quantized_model: test a W4A16 quantized model by verifying INT4 packed weights and converting to bfloat16
check_and_mark_quantized_module: check and mark quantized modules in a model to detect FP8, NVFP4, MXFP4, or WOQ weight types
convert_module_to_hp_if_necessary: convert compressed linear layers in a quantized model back to high precision bfloat16 weights
quantize_w4a16_to_mxfp4: quantize a W4A16 model to MXFP4 format using AutoRound and save with llm_compressor format
